20.summary: Get the Scepter first in Ruins of Lordaeron at 17, then finish the quests it starts in Undercity. Next, take the Grom'gol zeppelin for a Deadmines run, then go back through Orgrimmar to the Barrens for Wailing Caverns and one Blacksmithing session at Gor'mak. At 20, finish with the Friend of the Library turn-in and the AH pieces.

steps.title: Undercity: Ruins of Lordaeron pickups
steps.do: At 15-17, take the zeppelin from Orgrimmar to Tirisfal. In the Royal Quarter, pick up Light's Justice from Morbin Lightbane. Other Ruins of Lordaeron quests are nice XP but optional: The New Plague (Theodore Griffs, Apothecarium) and The Wrath of Rath'mael (Deathguard Kristof, on the road to Brill).

steps.title: Ruins of Lordaeron: The Abandoned and The Baron
steps.do: Run it at 17+ until the Scepter of the Abandoned drops from The Abandoned (about 35%). Your weapon comes first. Always loot the Abominable Head from The Baron, because it starts Unending Torment. Loot Intact Limbs from the undead for Light's Justice. Optional: Grip of Fear (The Abandoned) and Atrophic Girdle (Witherfang) hold your hands and waist until you craft the Crusader's pieces.

steps.title: Undercity: Unending Torment chain
steps.do: Take the Abominable Head to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Apothecarium and finish his chain for Slain Baron's Signet. It sends you around the city: the Unfinished Abomination, Blisterweed, Toxic Skullcap from Tawny Grisette, Essence of Agony from Ezekiel Graves, then the Hissing Serum. Turn in Light's Justice to Morbin while you're here. Optional: Spare Part Bindings is leather, and it covers your wrists until Sneed.

steps.title: The Deadmines: Sneed and Mr. Smite
steps.do: This is an ALLIANCE-TERRITORY trip. Take the Tirisfal zeppelin to Grom'gol, then run north through Duskwood into Westfall and down to Moonbrook. Group up before you go if you can. Farm Sneed for Bandsaw Wristbands (blocks trigger the thorns) and Mr. Smite for First Mate Band. Then go back through Grom'gol to Orgrimmar.

steps.title: Wailing Caverns: Verdan the Everliving
steps.do: Run at 19+ so you can equip Seedcloud Buckler. Kill Verdan the Everliving for Sporid Cape and the Buckler, about 32% each. Optional: Snake Eye Kaleidoscope from Lady Anacondra fills your neck until Friend of the Library. Leaders of the Fang (Wingblade) is optional. Its classic giver is Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff, but that's unconfirmed for Forever, and the Scepter is better for you anyway.

steps.title: Thorn Hill: Chol'aruk the Ravener
steps.do: Optional: Thornwoven Shield is a placeholder if Verdan won't drop the Buckler. Chol'aruk is a level-20 elite in a cave at Thorn Hill, close to the Crossroads, and you loot Chol'aruk's Head from him. The quest giver is unconfirmed. Don't put a spike on this shield, because spikes can't be moved to another shield.

steps.title: Craft session at Gor'mak
steps.zone: The Barrens (outside the Crossroads west gate)
steps.do: Buy the plans from Gor'mak for 30 Merchant's Favor each; they need no DSL rep: Crusader's Chain Belt (BS 45), Gloves (BS 80), Boots (BS 85) and Silvered Chain Helm (BS 95). The Belt needs 12 Copper Bar, 4 Rough Grinding Stone, 2 Pristine Leather and 2 Lesser Magic Essence. Other mats are unverified. The Helm needs level 20 to wear, so craft it now and equip it at 20. Buy Rough Bronze Shoulders on the AH if you don't have the plans. Optional: Strange Copper Boots (BS 35) is only worth making if you're still under 17.

steps.title: Level 20: legs, chest and shield spike
steps.do: Crusader's Chain Leggings (BS 95, needs level 20) comes from dropped plans, and the source is unconfirmed. Watch the AH for the plans. Optional: Defender Leggings of Magic (AH, level 18) fills legs until then. Buy Gloomshroud Armor on the AH, since the SFK trash drop rate is negligible. It needs level 20. Optional: Crusader's Chain Shirt (BS 80, dropped plans) is a chest placeholder. Make or buy an Iron Shield Spike and put it only on Seedcloud Buckler.

steps.title: Undercity: Friend of the Library
steps.do: Pick up library books while you level. At 20, turn in 10 books to Owen Thadd in the Magic Quarter and choose Scholarly Pendant. Do this on your next trip to Undercity.

notes: Four BiS pieces need level 20: Crusader's Silvered Chain Helm, Crusader's Chain Leggings, Gloomshroud Armor and the Friend of the Library quest (quest level 20). Seedcloud Buckler needs 19, and the Scepter needs 17.
Iron Shield Spike needs BS 150, which you probably won't reach by 20 while you're making 45-95 crafts. Buy one on the AH, or add it later. Spikes can't be moved, so only put one on Seedcloud Buckler.

Unconfirmed: where the plans for Crusader's Chain Leggings, Crusader's Chain Shirt, Rough Bronze Shoulders and Iron Shield Spike come from. Gor'mak's list shows 'Crusader's Silvered Chain Leggings' (BS 125), not 'Crusader's Chain Leggings' (BS 95). Check which item the sheet means.

Unconfirmed: the Wowhead tooltips don't show the quest rewards for Slain Baron's Signet (Unending Torment) or Spare Part Bindings (Light's Justice). The guides confirm the quests but not the item rewards.
Unconfirmed: the quest giver for Chol'aruk the Ravener, and whether Leaders of the Fang still rewards Wingblade in Forever.
Gloomshroud Armor's ~0.02% SFK trash drop isn't on Wowhead. Treat it as AH only.

25.summary: Shadowfang Keep first at 21-22 for Blade of Silverlaine and the Seal of Sylvanas quest. Then a Blacksmithing session at Gor'mak in the Crossroads, and finally a Blackfathom Deeps clear at 24-25 for the ring, trinket and belt.

steps.title: The Sepulcher: pick up SFK quests
steps.do: Fly to The Sepulcher and pick up the Horde Shadowfang Keep quests before zoning in. One of them rewards Seal of Sylvanas, and one rewards Bronzed Shoulderguards. Unconfirmed: in Classic the Seal came from 'Arugal Must Die'. The Forever quest name and giver are not verified.

steps.title: Shadowfang Keep: Baron Silverlaine and Arugal
steps.do: Weapon first: farm Baron Silverlaine for Blade of Silverlaine (req 21, about 32% drop). Finish the SFK quest chain and hand it in for Seal of Sylvanas. Optional: take Bronzed Shoulderguards from the other SFK Horde quest. It fills shoulders until you craft Sterling Silver Shoulders.

steps.title: Crossroads craft session: shoulders and leggings
steps.do: Buy Crusader's Silvered Chain Leggings plans from Gor'mak outside the Crossroads west gate. They need 30 MF and BS 125. Craft Sterling Silver Shoulders (BS 110, req 22). Their plans are a drop from an unconfirmed source, so check the Orgrimmar AH for the plans or for the BoE shoulders themselves. Mats are unverified, so expect mainly bronze/silver bars.

steps.title: Blackfathom Deeps: Ghamoo-ra, Gelihast, Aku'mai
steps.do: Fly to Zoram'gar Outpost and run BFD at 24-25. Kill Ghamoo-ra for Spiked Shell Band (req 22), Gelihast for Cursed Murloc Eye (req 24) and Aku'mai for Moss Cinch (req 25). Optional: if you already have Blackfathom Villainy, finish it here for Dark Ritual Leggings. It is only a stopgap before the crafted leggings.

notes: Moss Cinch and Crusader's Silvered Chain Leggings both require level 25, so they arrive at the very end of this bracket.
Wowhead tooltips confirm the boss drops: Blade of Silverlaine (Baron Silverlaine, ~32%), Spiked Shell Band (Ghamoo-ra, ~32%), Cursed Murloc Eye (Gelihast, ~32%), Moss Cinch (Aku'mai, ~29%).
Unconfirmed: the Forever quest names and givers for Seal of Sylvanas and Bronzed Shoulderguards. Wowhead item pages could not be read.
Unconfirmed: the Sterling Silver Shoulders plans source and the mats for both crafts. The leggings' 30 MF requirement is taken from the sheet.
Trinket 2 has no item listed ('None found'), so it has no step.
Moss Cinch is leather and its spell power is damage-only per the tooltip, not healing.
Skipped alts that are off-route: Thornweaver Drape and Snake Hoop (RFK), Crusader's Chain Helm (plans source unknown) and Crusader's Silvered Chain Shirt (the chest BiS is already owned).

30.summary: No new weapon this bracket, so the route is ordered by level requirement: Excavation Site: Wetlands at 28, Razorfen Kraul at 29-30, then one Blacksmithing session at level 30 with BS 150 for the belt and a fresh shield spike.

steps.title: Level Blacksmithing toward 150
steps.do: While questing from 25 to 28, keep levelling Blacksmithing with Iron Bars so you hit 150 by level 30. You need 150 to learn Justicar's Belt and to apply an Iron Shield Spike. Buy Plans: Iron Shield Spike on the AH when you see them.

steps.title: Excavation Site: Wetlands: Relic Guardian
steps.do: At level 28 or higher, run Excavation Site: Wetlands and kill the final boss, Relic Guardian. The Reliquary Mantle has about a 31% drop chance. Wetlands is Alliance-leaning territory, so watch out near Menethil. Optional: the same boss drops Ring of Power Regulation (about 29%), a caster ring you can keep if it drops.

steps.title: Razorfen Kraul: Blind Hunter and Charlga
steps.do: Run RFK at level 29-30. Clear toward Charlga Razorflank (Heart of Agamaggan, about 29%, requires level 30) and check the Blind Hunter's spawn on the way (Stygian Bone Amulet, about 33%, requires 29). Blind Hunter is a rare spawn, so you may need several runs.

items.name: Heart of Agamaggan + Iron Shield Spike

steps.title: Craft session: Justicar's Belt and new spike
steps.do: At BS 150, learn Justicar's Belt from a Horde Blacksmithing trainer and craft it (BoP, requires level 30). Craft an Iron Shield Spike from Iron Bars and grinding stones and put it on the Heart of Agamaggan. Spikes can't be moved, so the old Seedcloud spike is lost. Optional: Hard Gold Boots (BS 150, BoE, requires 30) upgrade Crusader's Boots on armor and Strength, if you have the plans and the gold.

steps.title: Optional: The Grave Knight (City of Dalaran)
steps.do: Optional: if you're in Hillsbrad anyway, pick up The Grave Knight from Melisara in Tarren Mill (requires 24) and kill Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran. Undead Knight's Bracers have more armor and Stamina than Bandsaw Wristbands but lose the on-block thorns.

notes: The Main hand is unchanged (Blade of Silverlaine, carried over), so there's no weapon to get first.
Heart of Agamaggan and Justicar's Belt both require level 30. Expect to finish this bracket's shield and belt right at 30.
Justicar's Belt: warcraft.wiki.gg lists it as BS 150, learned from a trainer. Its reagents and the exact trainer NPC are unconfirmed.

Plans: Iron Shield Spike: Metaforge lists them as a chest drop in Arathi Highlands and Alterac Mountains, and gives the reagents as Iron Bar plus Coarse Grinding Stone. Both are unconfirmed. Applying the spike needs BS 150, per the Wowhead tooltip.
Excavation Site: Wetlands: guides disagree on its level range (24-33). There may be a Horde quest from Relic Guardian's Titan Relic ('Elder Knowledge', unconfirmed).
Trinket 2 has no item in the sheet. The Seedcloud Buckler alt is flagged as new only because its name differs ('+ spike'); it was BiS in earlier brackets, so it's left out.

35.summary: Start the Skullbreaker chain in RFK, cross to Undercity for the Malcin follow-up and a Scarlet Monastery Library run, loop back through Kalimdor for Malcin, the Thunder Bluff turn-in and a Crossroads craft session, then hand in Skullbreaker in Undercity and take the zeppelin to Stranglethorn for The Drowned City at 35.

steps.title: Razorfen Kraul: Small Scroll from Charlga
steps.do: On the way, pick up Compendium of the Fallen from Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff. Kill Charlga Razorflank for the Small Scroll (40% drop, req 28), which starts the Skullbreaker chain. Skip the run if you kept the scroll from your level-30 Heart of Agamaggan runs.

steps.title: Undercity and Scarlet Monastery: Library
steps.do: Take the zeppelin from Orgrimmar to Undercity. Give the Small Scroll to Varimathras and accept the follow-up An Unholy Alliance (bring back Ambassador Malcin's Head). Then run SM Library for the Compendium of the Fallen. Scarlet Wristguards (req 31) is BoE and drops somewhere in SM; the exact mob is unconfirmed, so loot the Graveyard and Library trash or buy it on the AH.

steps.title: Ambassador Malcin and Thunder Bluff turn-in
steps.do: Zeppelin back to Orgrimmar. Kill Ambassador Malcin outside Razorfen Downs for his head; the quest is level 36, so bring a group. Then hand in Compendium of the Fallen to Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff and choose Vile Protector. Its spike is made in the next step: a spike can't be moved between shields, so put a new one on this shield.

steps.title: Crossroads craft session
steps.do: Buy Plans: Justicar's Gauntlet from Gor'mak outside the Crossroads west gate. It needs 60 MF and DSL Friendly, and you craft it at BS 175 (req level 35). Craft an Iron Shield Spike (BS 150) and apply it to Vile Protector; its plans are a drop or come from the AH. If you're not level 35 yet, craft the gauntlet after Undercity, before you head to Stranglethorn.

steps.title: Undercity: Varimathras turn-in
steps.do: Zeppelin to Undercity and give Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras. Choose Skullbreaker, which replaces Blade of Silverlaine as your weapon.

steps.title: The Drowned City: Primeval Elemental
steps.do: Take the Undercity zeppelin to Grom'gol. The entrance is underwater off the Stranglethorn coast: swim past The Vile Reef to the Sunken Hollow and look for the cavern with a large tablet. The Primeval Elemental is in the submerged southern room; kill the Undying Offering trolls to make it spawn. Heart of the Primeval drops 36% of the time, BoP, req 35.

notes: Skullbreaker is started first, but it finishes late. Its two quests are level 36 and send you to Undercity twice, so you can't get the weapon first unless you skip the other content.
Unconfirmed: whether Ambassador Malcin is elite, and exactly where he stands outside Razorfen Downs.
Vile Protector is confirmed by Wowhead as a choice reward from Compendium of the Fallen (Sage Truthseeker, Thunder Bluff; quest level 38). The book is in SM Library.
Scarlet Wristguards: the Wowhead tooltip says Binds when equipped (the sheet says '-'). It has no listed drop source, so the AH is a valid route.
Justicar's Gauntlet and Heart of the Primeval both require level 35, so you can only get them at the very end of this bracket. The Drowned City is listed as a level 35-42 dungeon.
Unconfirmed: the mats for Justicar's Gauntlet, and where Merchant's Favor and DSL rep come from. Check Gor'mak's tooltip before you farm.
Unconfirmed in Forever: where Plans: Iron Shield Spike drops. Classic lists it as a drop; the sheet says the plans need BS 125.

Heart of Agamaggan (the off-hand alt) was your level-30 BiS, so it's skipped here. Arena Master (the Trinket 2 alt, req 35) has no confirmed source. In Classic it came from the Gurubashi Arena chest in Stranglethorn, a contested PvP area, but this is unconfirmed for Forever.

40.summary: Weapon first in SM Cathedral (plus Armory shoulders and the Aegis), then The Drowned City, a Crossroads craft session, Razorfen Downs and finally Uldaman at 40 for the level-40 head piece and the necklace quest.

steps.title: Scarlet Monastery: Armory and Cathedral
steps.do: Fly to the Undercity and ride to the Monastery at 38-39. Run Armory for Herod, then Cathedral for Mograine and Whitemane; repeat Cathedral until the mace drops (equips at 39). The Aegis needs a new shield spike, made in the craft session.

items.name: Aegis of the Scarlet Commander + spike

steps.title: The Drowned City: Deathless Marrow and Risen Sentries
steps.do: Kill Deathless Marrow for the ring. Risen Sentry's Links is a ~1.8% BoE trash drop, so check the Auction House before farming. Optional: Berserker Shackles from Zul'Alai fills wrist on the same run if Scarlet Wristguards never dropped.

steps.title: Crossroads craft session
steps.do: Buy Plans: Warder's Gauntlet from Gor'mak outside the Crossroads west gate (60 MF, DSL Friendly; BS 175). Craft a fresh Iron Shield Spike for the Aegis, since the old one stays on Vile Protector. Warder's Boots need BS 200 and level 40, and the plans source is unconfirmed. Optional: Shining Mithril pieces (BS 195, BoE) are skill-ups on the way to 200, and Justicar's Boots (BS 200) can cover feet if you can't find the Warder's plans.

steps.title: Razorfen Downs: Tuten'kash
steps.do: Close to the Crossroads, so run this straight after the craft session. Tuten'kash drops both the cape (level 37) and the chest (level 40). Optional: take Extinguishing the Idol inside for Dragonclaw Ring, and kill Ragglesnout (rare spawn) for Boar Champion's Belt if he is up.

steps.title: Uldaman: Eric 'The Swift' and the necklace quest
steps.do: Fly to Kargath and pick up the Necklace Recovery chain (unconfirmed for Forever: classic giver is Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath). Finish Necklace Recovery, Take 3 inside Uldaman, and kill Eric 'The Swift' in the Lost Dwarves fight for the helmet (level 40).

steps.title: Later: Libram of Invocation
steps.do: This is an Enchanting 210 BoP craft, so a Blacksmith can't make or buy it. Skip it unless you level Enchanting. The formula vendor and its rep faction are unconfirmed.

notes: Level gates (Wowhead tooltips): Horned Viking Helmet, Carapace of Tuten'kash, Warder's Boots and Libram of Invocation all require level 40, so they're only usable at the very end of the bracket. Hand of Righteousness and the Aegis require 39.
Warder's Boots: BS 200 is confirmed by third-party databases (the sheet says ~200), but where the plans come from is still unknown. Mats are unverified.
Iron Shield Spike: the classic recipe was 8 Iron Bar + 4 Heavy Grinding Stone. This is unverified for Forever.
Unconfirmed: the Necklace Recovery quest givers and where they start, and the location and entrance of The Drowned City.
Libram of Invocation is effectively unobtainable for a Blacksmith-only character, because it is a BoP Enchanting craft.
Herod's Shoulder, Warder's Gauntlet and Risen Sentry's Links are mail. Swap to plate when the level-45 Warder's pieces come online.

45.summary: Run Zul'Farrak first for Dune Hacker (plus headdress and ring in the same run), then Uldaman for the cape, a Crossroads craft session for the Warder's pieces and the shield spike, and Maraudon at 45 for Putridus Wall. Wristguards and Thorium Belt close out the bracket at 45.

steps.title: Zul'Farrak: Zerillis, Zum'rah, Nekrum
steps.do: Fly to Gadgetzan at 42+ and run Zul'Farrak. Kill Zerillis for Dune Hacker (req 42, about 53% drop), then Witch Doctor Zum'rah for Blood Ritual Ring and Nekrum Gutchewer for Undying Headdress. Both are req 43 and BoP, so loot them at 42 and equip at 43. Repeat runs until all three drop.

steps.title: Uldaman: Galgann Firehammer
steps.do: Fly to Kargath and run Uldaman. Galgann Firehammer drops Emberscale Cape (req 42, about 26%). If you still need any Horde Uldaman quests, do them in the same run.

steps.title: Crossroads craft session: Pauldrons and spike
steps.zone: The Barrens (Gor'mak, outside the Crossroads west gate)
steps.do: Buy the Warder's Pauldrons plans from Gor'mak (60 MF, DSL Friendly) and craft them at BS 210 (req 42). In the same session, craft a Mithril Shield Spike (BS 215; 4 Mithril Bar, 2 Truesilver Bar, 4 Solid Grinding Stone) and keep it for Putridus Wall. Spikes can't be moved, so your current shield's spike stays on it. Meanwhile keep turning in MF and DSL toward Honored.

steps.title: Maraudon: Lord Vyletongue
steps.do: At 45, fly to Shadowprey Village and run Maraudon. Lord Vyletongue drops Putridus Wall (req 45, about 21%). Put the Mithril Shield Spike from the craft session on it right away.

steps.title: Level 45 finish: Wristguards and Thorium Belt
steps.zone: The Barrens / any Horde auction house
steps.do: Once you are DSL Honored with 90 MF, buy the Warder's Wristguards plans from Gor'mak and craft them (BS 225, req 45). Thorium Belt is BoE (req 45): the plans need BS 225 and take 12 Thorium Bar and 4 Red Power Crystal. Buying the belt from the AH is usually faster than finding the plans.

notes: Putridus Wall, Warder's Wristguards and Thorium Belt all need level 45, so you can only equip them at the very end of this bracket.
Warder's Wristguards need DSL Honored. If you aren't Honored yet, keep the Wristguards for the next bracket.
Mithril Shield Spike plans need BS 190. Unconfirmed: where to get the plans in Forever (in Classic they were a world drop). Check the AH.
Warder's Pauldrons and Wristguards mats are unconfirmed, because the tooltips don't list them.
Unconfirmed: whether Zerillis is always up in Forever's Zul'Farrak. In Classic he was a wandering rare elite.
Thorium Belt plans source is unconfirmed (the sheet says the same). Red Power Crystals come from Un'Goro, so crafting it yourself at 45 is slow.
Aegis of the Scarlet Commander is flagged as a new alt, but it was your level-40 BiS shield, so you already have it. It's not listed here.

50.summary: Weapon first in Blackrock Depths at 48, then the Sunken Temple quest while still in the Eastern Kingdoms. Cross to Kalimdor for Alcaz Prison and Maraudon, and finish with a Warder's craft session at Gor'mak once you are Honored with DSL.

steps.title: Blackrock Depths: Warder Stilgiss and Ring of Law
steps.do: Fly to Kargath (Badlands) and enter BRD through Blackrock Mountain. Kill Warder Stilgiss in the Vault for Arbiter's Blade (req 48, about 20% drop), the weapon upgrade that comes first. In the same runs, Anub'shiah is one of the random Ring of Law challengers: Carapace (25%) and Graverot Cape (15%) are req 50, so you can loot them now and equip them at 50. Optional: Fineous Darkvire drops Foreman's Head Protector (req 50) if you pass him.

steps.title: Sunken Temple: The Temple of Atal'Hakkar
steps.do: While you are still in the Eastern Kingdoms, fly to Stonard and pick up the Horde quest The Temple of Atal'Hakkar (in Classic it comes from Fel'Zerul; unconfirmed for Forever). Complete it in the Sunken Temple and turn it in to collect Guardian Talisman.

steps.title: Alcaz Prison: The Questioner
steps.do: Return to Kalimdor and fly to Brackenwall Village. Alcaz Island lies off the coast near Theramore, so watch for Alliance guards on the way. The Questioner drops Fingerbreaker Stamp (req 48, 36%). Optional: Girdle of Extracted Answers (req 48) also drops from The Questioner and covers waist until you can craft the Waistguard. Optional: Blazeroar drops Zarla's Snack Pouch (req 50). Mark of Captivity may drop here, but the boss is unconfirmed.

steps.title: Maraudon: Princess Theradras
steps.do: Fly to Shadowprey Village and clear to Princess Theradras, the final boss, for Elemental Rockridge Leggings (req 49, about 20% drop). Do this at 49 or later so you can equip the leggings at once.

steps.title: Craft session: Warder's set at Gor'mak
steps.do: With 90 MF and DSL Honored, buy Plans: Warder's Waistguard and Plans: Warder's Sabatons from Gor'mak. Craft the Sabatons (req 47) first, then the Waistguard at BS 250 (req 50). Warder's Gloves (BS 250, req 50) needs plans whose drop source is unconfirmed, so craft the gloves whenever you find them. Mats are unconfirmed, so check the plan tooltips before you farm.

notes: Wowhead tooltips list Graverot Cape, Carapace of Anub'shiah, Warder's Gloves, Warder's Waistguard and Foreman's Head Protector as req 50, so you can only equip them at the end of the bracket.
Anub'shiah is a random Ring of Law challenger, so the cape and chest may take several BRD runs.
Mark of Captivity (BoE, req 47): no Wowhead drop source is listed. If it doesn't drop in Alcaz Prison, buy it on the AH.
Plans: Warder's Gloves: Metaforge lists the plan at BS 250, but no source for the plan was found. If you can't find them, keep Warder's Gauntlet.
Sheet says Alcaz Prison for Girdle of Extracted Answers and Zarla's Snack Pouch. Wowhead names the bosses: The Questioner and Blazeroar.
The Forever quest giver for The Temple of Atal'Hakkar is unconfirmed. Fel'Zerul in Stonard is the Classic giver.

55.summary: Run Blackrock Depths at 54 for Naglering, then Dire Maul East for chest and ring, then Upper Blackrock Spire at 55 for the Hammer and Gyth's Skull. The weapon comes last because it requires level 55. Blackmaw Hold and Stratholme alternatives are optional extras at the end.

steps.title: Blackrock Depths: Golem Lord Argelmach
steps.do: At level 54, fly to Kargath (Badlands) and run BRD to Golem Lord Argelmach in the Manufactory for Naglering (req 54, ~20%). Optional: Magmus in the Grim Guzzler area drops Golem Skull Helm (req 51), which can cover Head until you get Gyth's Skull.

steps.title: Dire Maul East: Alzzin the Wildshaper
steps.do: Fly to Camp Mojache in Feralas and clear Dire Maul East to Alzzin the Wildshaper. He drops both Energized Chestplate and Ring of Demonic Potency (both req 54, ~16-18% each), so expect to farm him several times.

steps.title: Upper Blackrock Spire: Goraluk, Gyth and Rend
steps.do: At level 55, run UBRS. Goraluk Anvilcrack drops Mastersmith's Hammer (req 55, ~18%), and Gyth drops Gyth's Skull (req 55, ~16%). Optional: Warchief Rend Blackhand, a few rooms on in the same run, drops Spaulders of Valor. Only take them if your Warder's Pauldrons haven't been crafted yet.

steps.title: Blackrock Depths revisit at 55 (alternatives)
steps.do: Optional: if you are back in BRD at 55, General Angerforge drops Force of Will and Emperor Dagran Thaurissan drops The Emperor's New Cape (both req 55). These are only worth it on a run you are already doing. Your carried-over Guardian Talisman and Graverot Cape remain BiS.

steps.title: Later: Blackmaw Hold and Stratholme extras
steps.do: Optional: Withermaw in Blackmaw Hold (north Azshara, behind the furbolg gate, level 55-60) drops Bloodfur Bulwark (req 55, ~27%). It needs its own new shield spike, because a spike can't be moved from Putridus Wall. Optional: Skul, a rare in Stratholme, drops Skul's Cold Embrace. Skip it if you already have the Energized Chestplate.

notes: Weapon-first isn't realistic in this bracket. Mastersmith's Hammer and Gyth's Skull both require level 55, so UBRS comes at the end. Keep Arbiter's Blade until then.
Unconfirmed: whether UBRS in Forever still needs the Seal of Ascension key, as it did in Classic. Check before you form a group.
Wowhead confirms Naglering still has 'When struck in combat inflicts 3 Arcane damage to the attacker', which is a thorns effect.
Every source and level requirement in the sheet matched its Wowhead Forever tooltip. No contradictions found.
Unconfirmed: Blackmaw Hold's boss order and Withermaw's location inside it. The entrance is from web guides, not Wowhead.
Bloodfur Bulwark (2057 armor, 38 block, +15 block value) has better base stats than Putridus Wall, but it's listed as the alternative. Compare them in-game before you spend a spike on it.

60.summary: Shop the Orgrimmar AH for the BoE weapon and shoulders first, then craft the Enriched Thorium set at Honored DSL, run UBRS and a Dire Maul North tribute at 58, do the Mount Hyjal neck quest, and finish at 60 with the Booty Bay Undermine vendor.

steps.title: Orgrimmar AH: Sageblade and Stockade Pauldrons
steps.do: Buy Sageblade (BoE, requires 59); the plans drop only from raid bosses, so the AH is the realistic route. Buy Stockade Pauldrons (BoE world drop, requires 50) now so they fill shoulders for the whole bracket. Optional: Hand of Edward the Odd (BoE, requires 57) as a stopgap if Sageblade is not listed or until you hit 59.

steps.title: Shaper's Terrace: Muck Protectors quest
steps.do: Optional: do the Horde quest here for Reinforced Muck Protectors. They fill legs until the Enriched Thorium Leggings (requires 58, DSL Honored) are craftable. The quest name and giver are unconfirmed.

steps.title: Gor'mak craft session: Enriched Thorium set
steps.do: Reach DSL Honored and 120 Merchant's Favor, then buy the Enriched Thorium Helm, Breastplate and Leggings plans from Gor'mak and craft all three at BS 300 (they require level 57-58). Mats are unverified; expect mostly Thorium/Enriched Thorium bars, so stock up beforehand.

steps.title: UBRS: General Drakkisath
steps.do: At 58+, clear to General Drakkisath for Draconian Deflector (BoP, requires 58, about 21% drop, so plan on repeat runs). Put a new shield spike on it; spikes cannot be moved from your old Putridus Wall.

steps.title: Dire Maul North: tribute run
steps.do: Do a tribute run (leave the guards alive, kill King Gordok), then loot Mizzle the Crafty's tribute chest for Redoubt Cloak (BoP, requires 58). It is not a guaranteed pick, so repeat if it does not appear.

steps.title: Mount Hyjal: Work Well Done
steps.do: Complete the quest Work Well Done for Horn of Ve'han. The quest giver, the chain leading into it and how you reach Hyjal are unconfirmed, so check the quest in game before travelling.

steps.title: Booty Bay: Pix Xizzix at 60
steps.do: At level 60, spend Tarnished Undermine Reals at Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay (neutral town): Defender's Grip Stabilizer (125), Ring of Awareness (75), Libram of Law (~50), about 250 in all. All three require level 60, so save currency from your 55-59 dungeon runs.

steps.title: Later / optional alternatives
steps.do: Optional: Depleted Thorium Sabatons and Evergreen Shield are BS 300 BoE crafts that require level 60 (plan sources unconfirmed). Evergreen Shield has no Defense. Optional: Frostwolf Insignia Rank 6 needs high Frostwolf rep from Alterac Valley. Optional: Ouroboros Ring from a Blackmaw Hold quest (reward unconfirmed).

notes: Sageblade: Wowhead confirms BoE, requires 59. Crafting it needs the Master Swordsmith specialization. Classic data puts the plans on raid bosses (Azuregos, Onyxia or Ragnaros) with mats of 12 Arcanite Bar, 2 Nexus Crystal, 2 Flask of Supreme Power and 4 Enchanted Leather. None of this is confirmed for Forever.
Wowhead lists the Sageblade at 39-73 damage, but Metaforge's Forever page says 58-109. Check in game.

Unconfirmed: the quest giver and access route for Work Well Done (Mount Hyjal); the Shaper's Terrace quest for the Muck Protectors; how Tarnished Undermine Reals are earned in Forever. In Season of Discovery they came from level 55+ dungeon bosses once a day.
The Defender's Grip Stabilizer, Ring of Awareness, Libram of Law, Evergreen Shield and Depleted Thorium Sabatons all require level 60, so they only arrive at the very end of the bracket.
The sheet's 'spike' for Draconian Deflector is unnamed. Use the best spike you can make or buy (Thorium Shield Spike in Classic, unconfirmed in Forever).
Wowhead shows Draconian Deflector also has +8 Fire Resistance, which is not in the sheet. Ouroboros Ring has no Defense and no level requirement.
Enriched Thorium plan costs (120 MF, DSL Honored) come from the sheet. Wowhead tooltips do not show vendor data, and the item pages were blocked (403).
